reviews.title: Embarrassing
reviews.text: Seriously this is the WORST UI of any app of this type that’s out there. I’ve been an Adobe user for decades so I’m not unfamiliar with what usually happens with their products. They create something amazing. Then, over time, they iterate it to death. Beyond ANY recognition of the original elegant product. By the time you’re 3-5 years in, you’re dealing with a Frankenstein’s monster of an app. This one is no exception. It’s clunky. Laggy. It is so far from how a human would intuitively use an app, it’s astounding. I hate this app so much. Adobe should be embarrassed.

reviews.title: Used to be great
reviews.text:
This used to be one of the best tools to use for creating social media posts. Now it's awful. Nothing loads directly, it constantly freezes and crashes, and all of the functionality is gone. Every update makes it worse and worse. Selecting text to edit is impossible because the screen doesn't properly adjust so your keyboard constantly covers what you're trying to edit. Uploading photos as a new file no longer works properly, they just get put as a tiny image on a large white background. There's no back tracking when trying to select new fonts to use, so you constantly have to close the font selection tool and reopen it which is tedious. Everything that used to be great about this app was tossed in favor of finding new ways to make people pay for features.

Updated because now projects don't even load. Work just completely gone. This is an abysmal joke of an app.

I shouldn’t have to use an exterior AI bot to explain to me how A photo to whatever I’m doing, because the choice listed in the app is for a website prompt and not for the app. Disappointed. Really thought that Adobe would have a user-friendly app for this, and I was very wrong.

reviews.title: Really disappointed
reviews.text:
Really disappointed with Adobe Express. I paid £8.99 for a one-month subscription because I specifically needed the graphic materials and features advertised, but I found I couldn’t make much use of the service for the purpose I purchased it for. I felt like compared to most apps there’s a significant lack of material to make any use out of anything compared to other apps.

I requested a refund and was only given £2.61 back. I then appealed the decision, but Adobe cancelled my subscription completely, meaning I’ve now lost access several days before the end of the month I had already paid for.

I purchased the subscription on 26 August, so I expected to have access until around 26 September. Cancelling it early while only refunding a small portion of the original payment has left me extremely frustrated. 

Poor experience with both the product and the way the cancellation/refund has been handled. I expected much better from Adobe.

reviews.title: More & More Glitchy every update!
reviews.text: I pay for the premium membership, and I use this app daily for my business. However, each update makes this app more and more glitchy. I can no longer configure shadows with the last two updates. I have to exit the file and reopen it every single time I want to remove the background from an image. After I work on a file for a few moments, I can no longer select various elements from the drop-down menu on the right side. I have to tap them individually, which means I have to move everything else out of the way in order to select an element, then when I’m done working on that one, I have to move everything else back in place. This app was phenomenal 6-12 months ago. It is now almost unusable. Please fix this! Stop releasing untested updates that literally break the app every time! And don’t make me join several random websites in order to submit feedback to the development team.

reviews.title: DO NOT SUBSCRIBE
reviews.text:
Absolutely appalling service. I have NEVER dealt with a company that makes it so impossible to contact a real human being. Everything is AI, automated responses, or endless loops that lead nowhere. There is no meaningful customer support whatsoever.

I have been trying to cancel my subscription for over a year and have repeatedly been unable to do so. Now, over a year later, I am suddenly being charged again at more than three times the original subscription price, with no warning, no explanation, and no consent!!!!

The website frequently crashes or redirects when trying to manage subscriptions, which feels deliberate at this point. The cancellation process is unclear, inaccessible, and incredibly frustrating. I cannot afford to keep this subscription, yet I am being forced into continued payments.

Over the years, this company has taken hundreds of pounds from me for a service I have actively tried to cancel. This feels exploitative and deeply unethical. Adobe’s billing and customer support practices are unacceptable, and I would strongly warn others to think twice before subscribing unless they are prepared to fight just to leave.
